senses.gloss:
सृप् cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xxiii, 14) स॑र्पति (ep. and mc. also ˚ते; p. स॑र्पत् [see s.v.] and सर्पमाण; pf. ससर्प [1. du. ससृपिव] Br.; aor. असृपत्, AV.; Br.; असृप्त, Br. &c.; असार्प्सीत् or अस्राप्सीत् Gr.; fut. सर्प्ता or स्रप्ता, ib.; सर्प्स्यति, Br.; स्रप्स्यति, ib. &c.; inf. सर्पितुम्, MBh. &c.; सर्प्तुम् or स्रप्तुम् Gr.; -सृ॑पस्, Br.; ind.p. सृप्त्वा, ib.; -सृ॑प्य, AV. &c.; -सर्पम्, Br. &c.),
to creep, crawl, glide, slink, move gently or cautiously (सर्पत, ‘depart!’, Rājat.), RV. &c. &c.;
to slip into (acc.), AitBr.;
 (in ritual) to glide noiselessly and with bended body and hand in hand (esp. from the Sadas to the Bahiṣ-pavamāna), Br.; ŚrS.; ChUp. :
Pass. सृप्यते (aor. असर्पि), to be crept &c., MBh. &c.:
Caus. सर्पयति (aor. असीसृपत् or अससर्पत्), to cause to creep &c. (see अव-, अनु-प्र-, वि-√ सृप्) :
Desid. सि॑सृप्सति (see उत्-√ सृप्) :
Intens. सरीसृप्यते (AitĀr.), सरीसर्प्ति, p. सरीसृपत् (BhP.), to creep along or hither and thither, glide about &c. [cf. Gk. ἕρπω; Lat. serpere; see also सर्प.]
सृप m. the moon, (cf. सृप्र), L.
N. of an Asura (cf. सृम), Hariv.
सृप्त mfn. crept, crawled &c.
slipped out of (abl.) or into (loc.), ŚBr.; ChUp.
सृप्त n. a place crawled to, Kāś. on Pāṇ. ii, 3, 68.
सृप्मन् m. a serpent, L.
a child, L.
an ascetic, L.
सृप्र॑ mfn. slippery, oily (cf. सर्पि॑स्), RV.
smooth, supple, lithesome, ib.
सृप्र॑ m. the moon, L.
सृप्र (अम्), n. honey, L.
सृप्रा (आ), f. N. of a river, L.
सृप्र॑—करस्न (˚प्र॑-), mfn. having smooth or supple arms, RV.
सृप्र॑—दानु (˚प्र॑-), mfn. sprinkling fat or oil, ib.
सृप्र॑—भोजस् (˚प्र॑-), mfn. having fat or abundant food, ib.
सृप्र॑—वन्धुर (˚प्र॑-), mfn. having a smooth seat or box (as the chariot of the Aśvins), ib.
सृपाट m. a small leaf of a flower &c., L.
सृपाटी (ई), f. a kind of measure, L.
a shoe, L.
base metal, L.
a small book, L.
सृपाटिका f. the beak of a bird, L.
